description: Complete budget gaming setup for casual to mid-level gaming in 1080p.

components.notes: Core processing and graphics
Basic wireless controls
Audio communication and mic
Protects against voltage fluctuations
Dual screen setup for gaming comfort

networking: Standard home broadband connection. Connect via Ethernet to the main router for low-latency multiplayer gaming.
installation_notes: Connect the laptop to the external LG monitor via HDMI. Enable 100Hz refresh rate in Windows display adapter settings.
upgrade_path: 6 months: Upgrade RAM to 32GB. 12 months: Purchase external mechanical keyboard and gaming mouse combo.

description: Premium 1440p high-refresh rate gaming and content creation station.

components.notes: Workstation CPU and RTX 4060 graphics
Precision pointer and custom scroll wheels
Premium noise-cancelling headset
Maintains backup during gaming sessions
Secondary portrait screen for coding or chats

networking: WiFi 6 router connection required. Recommend connecting the laptop to an Asus AX1800 router via Cat6 LAN cable.
installation_notes: Connect the Dell monitor via Type-C to DisplayPort or HDMI. Enable G-Sync in NVIDIA Control Panel.
upgrade_path: 1 year: Add a high-performance external 1TB NVMe SSD for raw video capture storage.

description: Standard business desk setup for 5 employees performing billing, accounting, and operations.

components.notes: Reliable 3-year warranty desktop towers
FHD VA screens for spreadsheet clarity
Spill-resistant wireless keyboard and mouse
Network printer for high-speed monochrome invoicing
Individual UPS units per desktop to avoid data loss
Distributes office internet

networking: Configure the HP LaserJet printer on the local WiFi network. Connect all desktops to the network via Ethernet or WiFi adapters.
installation_notes: DCC technician will install the network printer and configure folder sharing across the 5 desktops.
upgrade_path: 1 year: Add a central Synology NAS storage tower for automated daily document backups.

description: Complete computer lab setup for schools and colleges, optimized for 25 student seating slots.

components.notes: Compact 7L towers to fit 2 students per desk
Affordable VA displays with eye protection
Durable wired keyboards to prevent battery theft
One 1100VA UPS powers two student desktops
For printing lab certificates and student reports
Deploys school lab wireless intranet network

networking: Configure static IP routing on the TP-Link router. Connect all 25 towers to a 24-port Gigabit switch via Cat6 cabling.
installation_notes: Position the 1100VA UPS units on bottom trays. Secure cables in wire trays to prevent accidental kicks by students.
upgrade_path: Year 2: Add a school server tower to run local educational database applications.

description: High-end compute workstation for local LLM fine-tuning, training, and 3D modeling.

components.recommendation: Acer Predator Helios Neo 16 Desktop Tower
components.notes: Intel HX processor + dual slot for heavy GPU expansion
Upgrade system RAM to 32GB or 64GB DDR5
Dual SSD layout: OS drive + dedicated high-speed dataset drive
Ensures clean power during heavy computational training runs
Secondary screen for monitoring terminal commands

networking: Connect to internet via gigabit Ethernet. Requires high-speed connection for downloading massive AI model weights.
installation_notes: Ensure the power outlet supports 15A loads. Keep the tower in an air-conditioned room to prevent GPU throttling during training.
upgrade_path: 6 months: Install a secondary liquid CPU cooler. 1 year: Upgrade storage to 4TB RAID arrays.

description: Professional surveillance setup for warehouses, hotels, and large residential buildings.

components.notes: Waterproof outdoor perimeter coverage
Indoor corridor and lobby coverage

components.recommendation: CP Plus 4-Channel UVR (Upgraded to 24-ch commercial NVR)
components.notes: Core video recording server
Handles continuous 24/7 video streaming records
Security guard desk monitoring display
Maintains DVR power during power cuts to avoid recording gaps
Enables remote mobile application viewing access

networking: Router should have a static IP or Dynamic DNS configured for stable remote viewing using the gCMOB mobile app.
installation_notes: Mount outdoor bullet cameras under roofs/sunshades to prevent glare from direct sunlight. Ground the coaxial cables to prevent lightning damage.
upgrade_path: 1 year: Add IP-based PTZ (Pan-Tilt-Zoom) tracking cameras at main entries.

description: High-speed video post-production editing workstation, optimized for 4K video rendering.

components.notes: Superfast M3 silicon with hardware ProRes video engines
Secondary color-accurate IPS reference monitor
Side scroll wheel for fast horizontal timeline navigation
High speed storage inside external Thunderbolt enclosure
Maintains power to external storage and monitors
For wireless voice-overs and audio checks

networking: Fast WiFi network (Asus AX1800) recommended for quick upload of finished projects to YouTube or Vimeo servers.
software: Final Cut Pro / Adobe Premiere Pro
installation_notes: Connect the MacBook Air to the Dell monitor using a USB-C to DisplayPort cable (delivers best 60Hz color accuracy).
upgrade_path: 6 months: Add a RAID 5 external desktop storage box for high-speed multi-gigabyte project backups.

description: Complete retail shop billing terminal, optimized for clothing stores, grocery shops, and pharmacies.

components.recommendation: HP Pavilion Slim S01 Desktop PC
components.notes: Space-saving billing counter tower
FHD screen for billing items display
Keeps billing counter quiet and cable-free
Prevents terminal reboot during sudden billing entries
Prints general letters, customer bills, and labels
Distributes WiFi to card swipe machines
Keeps watch on cashier counter and customer stands

networking: Configure a secure private WiFi network for the POS terminal and swipe machines. Set up a separate guest network for customers.
installation_notes: Connect the thermal billing printer and barcode scanner to USB 3.0 ports for maximum signal processing speeds.
upgrade_path: 6 months: Install an electronic cash drawer linked to the thermal billing printer.
